content:
With AirPods Pro 3 still down at a wild $100 off, and the crazy $400 price drop on M5 MacBook Air, it’s time to take stock of your Apple Home rig.

While you’re going to have a hard time securing the new HomeView with delivery any time soon at this point, there are loads of brilliant deals on gear to upgrade the rest of your Apple Home in the meantime. With the Black Friday deals still rolling and the Cyber Monday weekend sales now live, this is largely the best time of year to upgrade to that new Apple Home Key lock your front door needs from brands like Level Lock, Schlage, Aqara, and more. But it is also a great opportunity for expanding the Apple Home setup you already have with additional sensors, cameras, light switches, and plugs, and we have put together a range of the best HomeKit gear we have our eyes on this weekend while the deals are flying.

Level Lock+ and Pro with Home Key

I still love the ultra discreet look and simplicity of the Level Lock solutions. This is a lock that maintains a super clean and classic look, but packs in loads of tech Matter-Over-Thread, apple Home integration, and, on some models Apple Home Key tech. The basic Level Lock (Matter) at the $199 Black Friday price is a solid option as well, but the Level Lock+ (Matter) delivers Home Key action for just $18 more right now at Amazon all-time low pricing, and the latest Level Lock Pro delivers all of that and more in a premium package with support for Home Key as well as additional touch, key for, and keycard entry

  • Level Lock (Matter) Smart Lock $199 (Reg. $249)
  • Level Lock+ (Matter) Smart Lock w/ Apple Home Key $249 (Reg. $329)
  • Level Lock Pro w/ Home Key $299 (Reg. $349)

Schlage Sense Pro UWB Smart Deadbolt with Home Key

Schlage is easily one of the best in the smart lock business and a personal favorite of mine. Delivering robust hardware and feature-rich solutions, the stand out Black Friday and Cyber Monday Schlage deal this year would have to be the all-time low on the 2026 Schlage Sense Pro with Home Key – it is now over $110 off the the $399 list price.

  • Schlage Sense Pro UWB Smart Deadbolt w/ Home Key $287 (Reg. $399)

Aqara Home Key Locks and Apple Adaptive Temp gear

Aqara U series Smart Locks Aqara delivers some of the best bang for your buck in the Apple Home Key lock world and its latest Ultra-Wideband U400 model with Matter Over Thread, Home Key, and a whole lot more is currently sitting at the lowest price ever for Cyber Monday week $200 shipped. Just be sure to scope out the deal on and our hands-on review on the brand’s new W200 smart thermostat with Apple Adaptive Temperature support down at $120 (matching the lowest price ever).
